skill.summary: Turn a headshot photo and resume text into 1080p professional video CV just by typing what you need. Whether it's creating a video resume to send to employer...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Video CV Maker Free, enabling users to create and export professional 1080p video resumes from photos and resume text.
- Supports rapid creation: upload your content, describe the desired video, and receive a finished MP4 within minutes.
- Cloud-based rendering pipeline handles video composition, background music, aspect ratios, and text overlays automatically.
- No timeline editing or complex export settings required; simply specify your requirements in plain language.
- Supports common file formats (JPG, PNG, PDF, DOCX) with a 200MB upload limit.
- Includes a free credit system and anonymous access option for new users.
